question.text: $A B C$ is a triangular park with $A B=A C=100 \mathrm{~m}$. A TV tower stands at the mid-point of $B C$. The angles of elevation of the top of the tower at $A$, $B, C$ are $45^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}, 60^{\circ}$ respectively. The height of the tower is

solution.text: According to question, Let $D E=h$ and $C D=D B=x$ In $\triangle E B D, \quad \tan 60^{\circ}=\frac{h}{x} \Rightarrow x=\frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}$ Now, in $\triangle A D E$ $\begin{aligned} & \tan 45^{\circ}=\frac{E D}{D A} \\ & \Rightarrow \quad D A=h \end{aligned}$ In $\triangle A B D$, by applying Pythagoras theorem $\begin{aligned} & \Rightarrow \quad\left(\frac{h}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^2+h^2=100^2 \\ & \Rightarrow \quad \frac{4 h^2}{3}=10000 \quad \Rightarrow h=50 \sqrt{3} \end{aligned}$
